payload.core_mechanism_summary: Counts stick lengths of A, B, C; if difference is 0 keep; if difference is 2, adjust by moving one stick from larger side to smaller; else impossible.
payload.rationale: The solution uses direct arithmetic, not a search algorithm. No branching or bounding is performed. Forced to pick a complete_search subtype from candidates; branch_and_bound is least inappropriate but still a mismatch.
